# Three.js r170

Vendored from the `three@0.170.0` package on https://unpkg.com/three@0.170.0/.
The upstream files are unmodified. `build/three.module.min.js` is stored at this
directory's root, and `examples/jsm/` is stored under `addons/`. The monitor's
local import map resolves `three`; no runtime CDN access is required.

Includes OrbitControls, EffectComposer, RenderPass, ShaderPass, MaskPass, Pass,
UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass, and their CopyShader, LuminosityHighPassShader and
OutputShader dependencies. The original MIT license is in `LICENSE`.
